title: torulinium poeppigii
intro: Torulinium poeppigii, commonly known as Torreya, is a coniferous plant species native to the southeastern United States. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Torreya include its ability to stimulate circulation and support respiratory health, making it a potential treatment for conditions such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Torreya include alkaloids and terpenoids, which have been shown to possess antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
